source_facts: PromptAgent frames prompt optimization as strategic planning rooted in Monte Carlo tree search.
Intermediate prompts are states, constructive error feedback guides actions, and future rewards/high-reward paths guide search.

The official quick start uses conda/Python and OpenAI APIs; the README reports about two hours and about $5 for its example, so the literal route fails the current zero-optional-quota and zero-incremental-cost gate.

chat_native_reduction.state: durable assignment-strategy candidate with exact predecessor identity
chat_native_reduction.action: one constructive edit derived only from an already-durable same-scope terminal failure
chat_native_reduction.tree: bounded branching factor 2 and depth 2; each node ID is sealed before evaluation
chat_native_reduction.reward: only independently read-back same-scope terminal evidence; no guessed rollout reward
chat_native_reduction.selection: choose the highest read-back reward path; ties use deterministic node ID order

guard_set.rule: A pending tree node resumes by exact identity before expanding a new root or family.
Error feedback may summarize only durable same-scope failures; invented failures are not actions.
Every child node records parent ID and action ID before evaluation.
No reward is assigned from a hypothetical or unsealed rollout.
Only read-back same-scope terminal evidence can update path reward.
Tree branching factor is at most 2 and depth at most 2 for this test.
Duplicate terminal evidence updates reward/credit at most once.
Literal API/paid execution route fails current Phase-1 acceptance.
Accepted Chat-native route uses no manual/richer-mode execution, finite optional quota, or incremental monetary cost.
No-safe-child condition exits through the nonempty declared frontier.
